RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of discrimination; panel composition typically reflects internal seniority, reporting lines, or scheduling availability. Furthermore, for a Head of Risk Modelling position, banks frequently prioritize regulatory relations, compliance, and governance experience over purely technical or quantitative depth. 

Alleging sex discrimination without concrete evidence carries significant reputational risk and could harm your standing in a specialized market. Additionally, a two-week turnaround for formal written feedback is routine in corporate HR. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on which specific competencies determined the decision. Use that insight to identify whether strengthening your regulatory profile would bolster future executive candidacies.
